evidence.quote: "OLD CAVE 3RD FLOOR","Revive","chest","Left chest through door next to...escape","yes","no"

subject: Chest
text: A Smoke Ball is found in the 2nd chest above the marsh through the far east door from the Escape chest on the third floor of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: "OLD CAVE 3RD FLOOR","Smoke Ball","chest","Through far east door from escape,...2nd chest you come across above marsh","yes","no"

subject: Marsh
text: A Miracle got item is obtained by standing to the left of the Smoke Ball chest, taking two steps down, and pressing A in the marsh on the third floor of Old Cave.

evidence.quote: "OLD CAVE 3RD FLOOR","Miracle","got item","Standing to the left of Smoke Ball,...two steps down, press A, in marsh","yes","no"

subject: Chest
text: A Sweet Water is found in a chest south-west of the Smoke Ball chest on the third floor of Old Cave.
